result.summary: Found 1 visual layout issue in the “Fastest near you” carousel.

issues.description: The “Smash Bros Burgers” card is vertically offset about 28 px lower than the neighboring restaurant cards, causing the images, time badges, titles, and delivery fees to appear misaligned within the same row.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent top alignment and spacing to every carousel card so all thumbnails and text begin at the same vertical positions.
